_help: Edit freely; the report only measures and flags, it does not judge how a sound feels.
A family entry overrides 'defaults' key by key; set a limit to null to switch that test off.
click: number of >8 kHz energy spikes (a note cut while audible, a transient that outruns its body) > clicks_max. 0 = none allowed; null switches the test off.
too-harsh: (2-5 kHz share > share_2k_5k_max OR centroid > centroid_hz_max) AND attack <= harsh_attack_ms_max AND crest >= harsh_crest_db_min.
too-thin: share below 300 Hz < low_share_min OR spectral bandwidth < bandwidth_hz_min.
too-long: duration > duration_s_max OR tail (envelope peak to last point above -40 dB) > tail_s_max.
too-quiet / too-loud: active RMS differs from rms_target_db by more than rms_tolerance_db; also peak outside peak_dbfs_min..peak_dbfs_max, or clipped samples > clip_samples_max.
inconsistent: max-min LUFS across a family's variants > variant_lufs_spread_max, or (max-min)/median of centroid > variant_centroid_spread_max.

rms_target_db values are the median of the sounds committed when this file was written, so they detect drift, not absolute correctness. Durations come from the design lengths in kit_make_sfx.py plus headroom.
